correctness.rationale: All zero-only squares are 0^(2h). Every other admissible square uses both ones on opposite halves, so the middle-zero run j obeys j>=|i-k| and j congruent to |i-k| mod 2; this proves the exact three-run count, including empty runs. The length-2h spectrum is a rectangle/diagonal lattice count using a clipped quadratic Q(t). Uniform O(n^2) sum/integral comparison reduces cubic growth to V(a,b,c)=integral integral (b-|x-y|)_+; strict balancing a=c and one-variable differentiation identify unique proportions 2:3:2 and maximum coefficient 2/147. Compactness proves only-if asymptotic rigidity. An independent brute-string enumerator agreed on every length and total for all 216 triples a,b,c<=5.
